_note: School of Sport container context pack for academic-writing-introductory. The subject is the School of Sport as a whole (sport and exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, strength and conditioning), not one discipline. Worked examples vary their sport subject lesson to lesson. There is NO QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport and exercise science / sport domain knowledge; subject scheme/code/benchmarkId are therefore empty and context.label is "sport".
